title: Who Is Alice Huang, the Woman in the Middle of Nvidia’s Spy Scandal?
partialText: Alice Huang, who U.S. intelligence determined is a Chinese asset, emerged from the high-flying world of Shanghai finance to work with tech titans and obtain essential A.I. chips.

title: On the Defense: Takeaways From Hegseth’s Remarks on Articles of Impeachment

partialText: The charges accuse the defense secretary of illegally starting the war with Iran, directing extrajudicial killings and ignoring laws meant to minimize civilian casualties.

title: America’s Measles Problem Has Reached Endemic Level
partialText: A panel of scientific experts will convene on Tuesday to evaluate the United States’ measles elimination status. But genetic data already shows the virus is once again endemic.

title: House Republicans Pick Jim Jordan, a Close Trump Ally, as Their Next Leader

title: Anthropic’s Giant IPO Will Tie It Closer to Nvidia

title: ICE Hides Detainee Locations From Lawyers and Family Under New Policy

title: Every Wedding Has a Budget. What’s the Story Behind Yours?

title: Novaya Gazeta, Russia’s Bravest Newspaper, Closes
partialText: For more than 30 years, the paper covered an increasingly repressive Russia. “The process of silencing us started many years ago,” one of its journalists said.
